cards.name: Temporal Breach
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for Rune to react with later for 0.)
Banish a unit, then its owner plays it to the same location, ignoring its cost.
cards.flavor_text: For the important things, you can always make time.

cards.name: Tomb-Raider Barbara
cards.description: When you play me, if you control 7 or more runes, choose an enemy gear. If it's [EMPOWERED], disempower it. Otherwise, kill it.
cards.flavor_text: Wait for her signal. Don't worry, you'll know.

cards.name: Tools of Empire
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 2] (2: Empower this. Use only if not Empowered.)
Exhaust: Give a unit +2 Might this turn. If this is [EMPOWERED], give that unit +4 Might this turn instead.
cards.flavor_text:
"We will unearth what has been lost."
—Azir

cards.name: Twilight Shroud
cards.description:
Give a friendly unit +1 Might this turn. It can't be chosen by enemy spells and abilities this turn.
[FLOW 2] (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)
cards.flavor_text: "I make problems … disappear." —Akali

cards.name: Vi - Destructive (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
[GANKING]
Recycle 1 from your trash: Give me +1 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: "I like you as far as I can throw you … not even."

cards.name: Viktor - Innovator (Overnumbered)
cards.description: When you play a card on an opponent's turn, play a 1 Might Recruit unit token to your base.
cards.flavor_text: "You betray your future."

cards.name: Wild Claw
cards.description: Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish a unit or gear from among them and play it, reducing its Energy cost by 5. Recycle the rest. Then you may do this: Empower it. (It becomes Empowered if it's not already.)

cards.name: Wind and Ghosts
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Choose a unit at a battlefield. If it has 3 Might or less, banish it. Otherwise, return it to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor_text: The best strategy is to not have an enemy.

cards.name: Zed - From the Shadows
cards.description:
You may discard 1 as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, play a 0 Might Shadow Clone unit token. (It has "When I attack, you may banish a unit from your trash. If you do, give me [ASSAULT 4] this turn.")
cards.flavor_text: "No technique is forbidden."

cards.name: Zed - From the Shadows (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
You may discard 1 as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, play a 0 Might Shadow Clone unit token.
cards.flavor_text: "Challenge me, Shen … You shall not be an orphan long!"

cards.name: Zed - From the Shadows (Alternate Art)
cards.clean_name: Zed From the Shadows Alternate Art
cards.description:
You may discard 1 as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, play a 0 Might Shadow Clone unit token.
cards.flavor_text: "No technique is forbidden."

cards.name: Zed - Without a Sound
cards.description:
When I conquer, play a 0 Might Shadow Clone unit token to your base. (It has "When I attack, you may banish a unit from your trash. If you do, give me [ASSAULT 4] this turn.")
[ACTION] 1 and 1 Chaos: Move me and a Shadow Clone you control to each other's locations.

cards.name: Zed - Without a Sound (Alternate Art)
cards.clean_name: Zed Without a Sound Alternate Art
cards.description:
When I conquer, play a 0 Might Shadow Clone unit token to your base.
[ACTION] 1 and 1 Chaos: Move me and a Shadow Clone you control to each other's locations.
cards.flavor_text: "The truth lies in darkness."

cards.name: Vendetta - Showdown Decks: Zed vs Shen Display
cards.clean_name: Vendetta Showdown Decks Zed vs Shen Display

cards.name: Acceleration Gate
cards.description: Ready up to 4 units, gear, and/or runes.
cards.flavor_text:
"Energize!"
—Jayce

cards.name: Affectionate Poro
cards.description: When a combat that I was in ends, if I haven't been dealt damage this turn, draw 1.
cards.flavor_text: Cuteness is a survival skill.

cards.name: Ambessa - Respected and Feared (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 1 and 2 Order]
[EMPOWERED] I have [ASSAULT 2].
[EMPOWERED] When I attack, kill an enemy unit here with less Might than me.
cards.flavor_text: "Have you finally realized your potential, Mel?"

cards.name: Ambessa - The Wolf
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 3 and 1 Body] (3 and 1 Body: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have +3 Might and can't be dealt damage unless I'm in combat.
cards.flavor_text: "I will never stumble, never break."

cards.name: Ambessa - The Wolf (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 3 and 1 Body]
[EMPOWERED] I have +3 Might and can't be dealt damage unless I'm in combat.
cards.flavor_text: "I will never stumble, never break."

cards.name: Applied Researchers
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 3] (3: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] Your spells cost 1 and 1 Rune less, to a minimum of 1.
cards.flavor_text: "Prognostication Test 11: Successful, but Tests 14 and 19 will fail. What happens if we skip them?"

cards.name: Astral Heron
cards.description: When you play your first card each turn, if I'm at a battlefield, your next card costs 2 and 2 Runes less.
cards.flavor_text: With its flight, the night falls.

cards.name: Aurok General
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 3 and 1 Order] (3 and 1 Order: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] Your units that are [EMPOWERED] have +2 Might (including me).
cards.flavor_text: "Heed my command."

cards.name: Baccai Sandspinner
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 5]. This ability costs 3 less if you control 4 or fewer runes. (Pay the cost: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have [DEFLECT] and [ASSAULT 2]. (Opponents must pay Rune to choose me with a spell or ability. +2 Might while I'm an attacker.)

cards.name: Baccai Witherclaw
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 1 and 2 Runes] (1 and 2 Runes: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have +2 Might.
[EMPOWERED][DEATHKNELL] Channel 2 runes exhausted. (When I die while Empowered, get the effect.)

cards.name: Brittle Steel
cards.description:
Kill a gear.
[FLOW 4 and 1 Fury] (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)
cards.flavor_text: Cold is older than stone, older than steel. And when these are gone, the cold will remain.

cards.name: Brutal Hunter
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 3] (3: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have +2 Might and [GANKING]. (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)
cards.flavor_text: Proof of her success was often a mess to sort through.

cards.name: Cataclysmic Duel
cards.description: Each player chooses a unit they control. Kill the rest.

cards.name: Clairvoyance
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
[PREDICT 5]. (Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. Recycle any of them and put the rest back in any order.)
Draw 2.

cards.name: Consuming Curse
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Deal 2 to a unit at a battlefield. This deals 1 Bonus Damage for each card with this name in your trash.
cards.flavor_text:
"WHAT WAS THAT?!"
—Common last words

cards.name: Covert Informant
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 3] (3: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] When I move, draw 1.
cards.flavor_text: When one person knows, it's a secret. When two know, it's a deal.

cards.name: Crumbling Sands
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Counter a spell if an opponent has played another spell this turn.
cards.flavor_text: Time will reduce all greed to dust.

cards.name: Decree of Focus
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Choose a friendly unit that's in combat with an enemy Fury (Fury) unit or that's being chosen by an enemy Fury spell. Give it +4 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: Rage is a quagmire. Tread lightly.

cards.name: Decree of Rage
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
This can't be countered.
Deal 4 to an enemy Calm (Calm) unit.
cards.flavor_text: Peace is paralysis. Get moving.

cards.name: Decree of Strength
cards.description: Choose an opponent. They reveal their hand and you choose a Mind (Mind) card from it. They recycle that card.
cards.flavor_text: Caution is a labyrinth. Smash through.

cards.name: Decree of Unity
cards.description: Kill an enemy Chaos (Chaos) unit or gear.
cards.flavor_text: Disorder is isolation. Reach out.

cards.name: Jayce - Defender of Tomorrow (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 2 and 2 Runes]
1, Exhaust: Ready a gear.
[EMPOWERED] 1, Exhaust: Ready 2 gear.

cards.name: Diana - No Longer Human (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
[AMBUSH]
When you play a spell, give me +2 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text:
Their dearest wish is to share a sky
Made large enough for both to dance
With hands and hearts entwined
—Hymn of Dawn

cards.name: Disciple of Shen
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for Rune to react with later for 0.)
I have [SHIELD 3] while I'm at a battlefield with exactly one other unit you control. (+3 Might while I'm a defender.)
cards.flavor_text: Even twilight itself takes on an apprentice or two.

cards.name: Dragon Form
cards.description:
Choose a unit. Its base Might becomes 5 this turn.
[FLOW 3] (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)
cards.flavor_text: "The Dragon spirit is not magic. It is life, more ancient than ours." —Lee Sin

cards.name: Dragon Roost
cards.description: Any player may pay 2 Runes as an additional cost to play a Dragon. If they do, they play it to this battlefield.

cards.name: Draven - Showboat (Overnumbered)
cards.description: My Might is increased by your points.
cards.flavor_text: "Doesn't get better than this."

cards.name: Dredge Up
cards.description:
Draw 1.
[FLOW 2] (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)
cards.flavor_text: By hook and for crook.

cards.name: Dune Surfer
cards.description: You ignore [TANK] while assigning combat damage here.
cards.flavor_text: "Look at this rug! How can one child track this much sand?!"

cards.name: Endless Riches
cards.description:
When you play this, banish your hand and trash, then [BURN 7].
Skip your Draw Phase.
You may play cards from your trash.
If a card would go to your trash from anywhere other than your Main Deck, banish it instead.

cards.name: Escaped Grayback
cards.description:
[EMPOWER] — Kill a friendly unit (Pay the cost: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have +2 Might.
cards.flavor_text: "Strength comes from the will to be free."

cards.name: Fallen Feline
cards.description:
When you play me, name a spell.
While I'm at a battlefield, opponents can't play spells with that name.
cards.flavor_text: Cat got your tongue?

cards.name: Forgotten Relic
cards.description: When you play this or at the start of your Beginning Phase, [BURN 1]. When you burn a unit this way, do this: Give a friendly unit +Might equal to the burned card's Might this turn. (To Burn 1, put the top card of your Main Deck into your trash.)

cards.name: Forsaken Baccai
cards.description: If you control fewer runes than an opponent at the start of your Beginning Phase, give me +1 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: Baccai lurk in the shadow of the failed Sun Disc at Nerimazeth, plotting their return to glory.

cards.name: Fretful Feline
cards.description: When I become ready, give me +2 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: He'd be less eager to escape if he knew what was out there.

cards.name: Frostcoat Mother
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 12]. This ability costs 1 less for each rune you control. (Pay the cost: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have +3 Might.
cards.flavor_text:
Few step between a mother and her pack.
None do it twice.

cards.name: Grumpy Rockbear
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 12]. This ability costs 1 less for each rune you control. (Pay the cost: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have [DEFLECT] and [SHIELD 3]. (Opponents must pay Rune to choose me with a spell or ability. +3 Might while I'm a defender.)

cards.name: Guttural Roar
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Give a unit +2 Might this turn. If it's [EMPOWERED], give it +4 Might this turn instead.
cards.flavor_text: The Butcher of the Sands is not known for his patience.

cards.name: Hand Hammer
cards.description:
[EQUIP Calm] (Calm: Attach this to a unit you control.)
I have +2 Might while I'm at a battlefield with exactly one other unit you control.
+1 Might

cards.name: Helm of Suppression
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 4 and 1 Calm] (4 and 1 Calm: Empower this. Use only if not Empowered.)
Opponents' spells cost 1 more. If this is [EMPOWERED], they cost 1 and 1 Rune more instead.
cards.flavor_text: "Are we having fun yet?"

cards.name: Hungry Wolf
cards.description: Order: Ready me and give me +1 Might this turn. Use only if you've chosen an enemy unit this turn and only once each turn.
cards.flavor_text:
"A wolf has no mercy."
—Ambessa

cards.name: Irelia - Fervent (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
[DEFLECT]
When you choose or ready me, give me +1 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: "Did you wanna lose the other one too?"

cards.name: Iterative Design
cards.description:
Play a 3 Might Mech unit token.
[FLOW 2 and 1 Mind] (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)
cards.flavor_text: It's not always a bad thing to reinvent the wheel.

cards.name: Kai'Sa - Survivor
cards.description:
[ACCELERATE]
When I conquer, draw 1.

cards.name: Kayle - Justified
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 3] (3: Empower me.)
I can be [EMPOWERED] up to three times.
I have +2 Might for each time I'm [EMPOWERED].
While I'm [EMPOWERED] three times, I have [DEFLECT 3] and [GANKING].

cards.name: Kayle - Justified (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 3] (3: Empower me.)
I can be [EMPOWERED] up to three times.
I have +2 Might for each time I'm [EMPOWERED].
While I'm [EMPOWERED] three times, I have [DEFLECT 3] and [GANKING].
cards.flavor_text: "Not murder. Justice."

cards.name: Kennen - Storm of Shuriken (Alternate Art)
cards.clean_name: Kennen Storm of Shuriken Alternate Art
cards.description:
When you play me, [BURN 2].
When I conquer, give a spell in your trash [FLOW] equal to its cost this turn.
cards.flavor_text: "Time to strike!"

cards.name: Kharox
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 6 and 2 Chaos] (6 and 2 Chaos: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
When I become [EMPOWERED], choose an opponent. They [BURN 3]. Then you may do this: Choose a unit in their trash and play it, ignoring its cost. (To Burn 3, they put the top 3 cards of their Main Deck into their trash.)

cards.name: Kinkou Temple
cards.description: Units here with [TANK] have +1 Might.

cards.name: Legion Marauder
cards.description:
[EMPOWER] — 1 or Body (Pay either cost: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have +1 Might.
cards.flavor_text: The Trifarian Legion always has strength in numbers, even when that number is one.

cards.name: Leona - Determined (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
[SHIELD]
When I attack, stun an enemy unit here.
cards.flavor_text:
Instead they must steal glances
Wait for the other to approach
Or watch the other depart
—Hymn of the Dawn

cards.name: Masa, Crashing Thunder
cards.description:
You may pay Order as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, [STUN] an enemy unit at a battlefield. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)
cards.flavor_text: He's louder than he looks, which is saying quite a bit.

cards.name: Mask Mother
cards.description: When you discard me, you may pay 1 to give a friendly unit +2 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: She is mother to all who fall.

cards.name: Mel - Defiant Soul (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
[EMPOWER] — Discard a spell
When I become [EMPOWERED], banish an enemy unit at a battlefield with 3 Might or less.
cards.flavor_text: "I deserve everything I've attained; I know that now."

cards.name: Minah Swiftfoot
cards.description:
When I move to a battlefield, choose one —
• Each player discards 1.
• Each player draws 1.
cards.flavor_text: She's mastered ten styles of combat, but she's still working on a good catchphrase.

cards.name: Morgana - Vindictive (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
[AMBUSH]
When you play me, deal damage to a unit equal to the damage marked on it.
cards.flavor_text: "Mother must be so proud of all of your murders, Kayle."

cards.name: Mystic Vortex
cards.description: During showdowns here, cards with [REACTION] cost Rune more to play. (Hidden cards have [REACTION].)

cards.name: Nasus - Guardian of Knowledge (Overnumbered)
cards.description: Once each turn, when an enemy unit here dies, channel 1 rune exhausted.
cards.flavor_text: "Rage burned away all that was good in you, my brother."

cards.name: Noxian Emissary
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 1 and 1 Order] (1 and 1 Order: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED][DEATHKNELL] Play two 1 Might Recruit unit tokens to your base. (When I die while Empowered, get the effect.)
cards.flavor_text: He speaks with the full might of Noxus behind him.

cards.name: Onslaught
cards.description:
Give a unit +6 Might this turn.
[FLOW 4] (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)
cards.flavor_text: When hitting them hard isn't enough, try hitting them again.

cards.name: Otterpus
cards.description: If a player would score 1 point from conquering or holding during their first or second turn, they draw 1 instead.
cards.flavor_text: Bandle Scout Rule 99: Make sure to keep all food out in the open. You never know who might want a snack!

cards.name: Pakaa Protector
cards.description: When I move, reveal the top card of your Main Deck. If it's a unit, draw it. Otherwise, put it in your trash and give me +2 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text:
"There's no such thing as a pakaa cub on its own."
—Wilderness survival tip

cards.name: Pendulum Blade
cards.description:
[EQUIP Fury] (Fury: Attach this to a unit you control.)
When I move to a battlefield, give me +2 Might this turn.
+1 Might

cards.name: Platewyrm Egg
cards.description:
This enters exhausted.
[EMPOWER] — 1, Exhaust (Pay the cost: Empower this. Use only if not Empowered.)
[REACTION] Exhaust: [ADD] 1. If this is [EMPOWERED], [ADD] 2 instead.

cards.name: Plaza Guardian
cards.description:
I cost 1 less for each gear you control.
[DEFLECT] (Opponents must pay Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.)
cards.flavor_text: There was uproar at first, but the community learned to ignore it soon enough.

cards.name: Profiteer
cards.description: When you play me, you may disempower something you control to empower a legend, unit, or gear.
cards.flavor_text: "Let's make a deal, shall we?"

cards.name: Protective Sands
cards.description: When you conquer here, if you control 4 or fewer runes, you may pay 1 to draw 1.

cards.name: Public Execution
cards.description:
Choose a friendly unit. Kill an enemy unit with less Might than it.
[FLOW 5 and 2 Runes] (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)
cards.flavor_text:
"This ends in ruin!"
—Ambessa

cards.name: Renekton - Brute (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
1: Give me +1 Might this turn.
When my Might becomes 10 or more, empower me.
[EMPOWERED] I have [DEFLECT] and [GANKING].
cards.flavor_text: "Embrace the jaws of death."

cards.name: Renekton - Brute
cards.description:
1: Give me +1 Might this turn.
When my Might becomes 10 or more, empower me. (I become Empowered if I'm not already.)
[EMPOWERED] I have [DEFLECT] and [GANKING]. (Opponents must pay Rune to choose me with a spell or ability. I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)

cards.name: Renekton - Brute (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
1: Give me +1 Might this turn.
When my Might becomes 10 or more, empower me.
[EMPOWERED] I have [DEFLECT] and [GANKING].
cards.flavor_text: "You are not my brother, traitor!"

cards.name: Repair Specialist
cards.description: I have [ASSAULT] equal to the number of gear you control. (+1 Might while I'm an attacker for each instance of Assault.)
cards.flavor_text: What is discarded by Piltover gets a second chance in Zaun.

cards.name: Resonating Strike
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for Rune to react with later for 0.)
[REACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Choose a battlefield you control and a unit you control at a different location. Move that unit to that battlefield and give it +2 Might this turn.

cards.name: Riven - Shattered (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
[WEAPONMASTER]
When I attack, choose an enemy unit here. Deal 2 to it for each Equipment attached to me.
cards.flavor_text: "Violence to end violence …"

cards.name: Ruthless Strike
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
As an additional cost to play this, you may discard 1.
Deal 3 to a unit at a battlefield. If you paid the additional cost, deal 5 to it instead.
cards.flavor_text: If you choose to destroy, hold nothing back.

cards.name: Sanction
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Choose one —
• Empower a unit. Disempower it at end of turn.
• Disempower a unit that's [EMPOWERED]. Empower it at end of turn.

cards.name: Sandstone Chimera
cards.description: While I'm at a battlefield, players only channel 1 rune at the start of their Channel Phase.
cards.flavor_text: Past timeless winds and storms, she wills the tides of sand to still.

cards.name: Serene Ascetic
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 3] (3: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have [DEFLECT] and [SHIELD 3]. (Opponents must pay Rune to choose me with a spell or ability. +3 Might while I'm a defender.)

cards.name: Shadow Dash
cards.description:
Move an enemy unit to a battlefield where you have units. If you have exactly two units there, they each get +1 Might this turn.
[FLOW 5 and 2 Runes] (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)
cards.flavor_text:
"Tread carefully."
—Shen

cards.name: Shadow Fiend
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 2 and 1 Fury] (2 and 1 Fury: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have [ASSAULT 3]. (+3 Might while I'm an attacker.)
cards.flavor_text: It justifies every fear of the dark.

cards.name: Shadow Temple
cards.description: When you hold here, [BURN 3]. (Put the top 3 cards of your Main Deck into your trash.)

cards.name: Shadowblade Lurker
cards.description: I cost 2 less for each card with my name in your trash.
cards.flavor_text: You'll never see the second one coming.

cards.name: Shen - Scourge of Shadows (Overnumbered)
cards.description: When I hold, if there is exactly one other unit you control here, draw 1.
cards.flavor_text: "You're already dead. You just haven't caught up yet."

cards.name: Shock Blast
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
This costs 2 less if you control something that's [EMPOWERED].
Deal 4 to a unit at a battlefield.
cards.flavor_text:
"Feel the thunder!"
—Jayce

cards.name: Solari Sunhawk
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 2] (2: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
[EMPOWERED] I have +1 Might and [DEFLECT 2]. (Opponents must pay 2 Runes to choose me with a spell or ability.)
cards.flavor_text: At its cry, the dawn breaks.

cards.name: Soulspinner
cards.description: [AMBUSH] (You may play me as a [REACTION] to a battlefield where you have units.)
cards.flavor_text: There are worse fates than being eaten.

cards.name: Spiderling
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for Rune to react with later for 0.)
I have +1 Might for each other unit you control here with my name.
Your deck can have any number of cards named Spiderling.
cards.flavor_text: Well, at least there's only one.

cards.name: Stargazer
cards.description: Spells with [FLOW] you play from your trash cost 2 less, to a minimum of 1.
cards.flavor_text: "I think that one looks like a dragon!"

cards.name: Swain - Visionary (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
[VISION]
When I conquer, if you've played a non-token unit, a non-token gear, and a spell this turn, you score 1 point.
cards.flavor_text: "Am I to seek revenge for my poor departed arm? If anything, girl, you did me a favor."

cards.name: Swain - Visionary
cards.description:
[VISION] (When you play me, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)
When I conquer, if you've played a non-token unit, a non-token gear, and a spell this turn, you score 1 point.
cards.flavor_text: "They are five steps from realizing I am ten steps ahead."

cards.name: Tail-Cloaked Matriarch
cards.description:
[EMPOWER 2 and 1 Chaos] (2 and 1 Chaos: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.)
When I become [EMPOWERED], you may choose a unit in your trash with Energy cost no more than 3 and Power cost no more than Rune. Play it to your base, ignoring its cost.

cards.name: Threshold of the Gray
cards.description: When combat starts here, the attacker and defender each [ADD] 1.

cards.name: Tornado Warrior
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for Rune to react with later for 0.)
When you play me from face down, you may empower something here. Disempower it at end of turn.
cards.flavor_text: There is a safe spot in every whirlwind, but it's easy enough to hit your enemies with the other parts.

cards.name: Twilight Reveler
